description: Débit aux affluent et effluent de la station d’épuration (saison estival 2015) (archives) is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Montréal. Cet ensemble présente les données liées affluent et effluent de la station d'épuration pendant la saison estivale de 2015. Ces données ont fait l’objet de traitements spéciaux (efforts de simulation et estimation) pour offrir plus de latitude aux prototypes développés dans le cadre de l'évènement Aquahacking 2016. Coverage: Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Ville de Montréal. Its tags are Affluent, Aquahacking, Eau, Effluent, Fleuve Saint-Laurent. It offers 2 resource(s) in PDF, XLS. The portal shows 2025-02-26 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
